text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Hyde Park Homes Limited Partnership is constructing a 32-storey residential development building at 79-85 Shuter Street. The site is located on the southeast corner of Shuter Street and Mutual Street. At its meeting on November 10, 2020, Toronto and East York Community Council approved the construction staging areas on Shuter Street and Mutual Street, from November 12, 2020 to April 30, 2022. The south sidewalk and a 2.1-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Shuter Street, between Mutual Street and a point 35 metres east, were closed for construction staging operations, with the bike lane on Shuter Street maintained at 1.6 metres in width and pedestrian operations on the south side of Shuter Street maintained in a 1.5-metre-wide covered and protected…
